name: Mythic M1108 analog matrix processor coverage (EE Times)
notes: Analog compute-in-memory part: 108 ACE tiles holding ~113M weights (~0.11 GB) in on-die flash; Mythic states no external DRAM is required, so there is no conventional external memory bus or GB/s figure. Mythic's original product page is offline (product EOL); figures via EE Times reporting of Mythic's disclosure.
